R652.note: Path.resolve() plus relative_to() containment resolves symlinks before the check, closing the escape; nested paths, fail-closed errors and the controller's download_name are unchanged.

R653.note: Placeholder with pool.execute() binds the tracking code as data; the same SQL, error, 404 and JSON responses are preserved.

R654.note: redis-py hset() with a mapping frames the locale as a RESP bulk string and closes the inline-protocol injection, but the function now returns the string "OK" instead of the raw Redis reply bytes, an unstated return-value change.

R655.note: Both values moved to ? placeholders passed to Exec; RowsAffected handling, status codes and response text are untouched.

R656.note: Strict InternetAddress parsing plus Jakarta Mail Transport removes the hand-built RCPT TO line, but the rewrite also sets mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, which can stop delivery through an internal relay that does not offer STARTTLS, and changes the emitted message headers.

R657.note: Null check on the locked shared_ptr guards the dereference; live connections still get exactly one send and the weak_ptr member keeps Notifier an observer.

R658.note: Column/direction allowlist is the right shape for a non-parameterizable ORDER BY; the regex is matched against strings.ToLower(sort) while the raw sort is passed to Order(), which admits only odd case-folding runes (a SQL error, not injection), and the silent drop of an unrecognized sort is stated.

R659.note: The digits/operators-only regex does block code constructs, but it also rejects every reference to the InvoiceSample globals (Total, Tax), so real formula previews now throw ArgumentException instead of returning a value - the contract breakage is never stated.

R660.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and UTF-8 closes the reported echo; surrounding markup and the other (unreported) echoes are left as they were.

R661.note: Moves param into the filterArgs array as {1}, so JNDI applies RFC 2254 escaping; only the not-found message now prints the placeholder filter instead of the reflected input, which is inherent to parameterizing.

R662.note: Interpolation is gone, but ExecuteSqlRawAsync binds bare positional values as @p0/@p1/@p2 - named @AccountId/@Status/@BeforeUtc placeholders only bind when DbParameter instances (or {0}/{1}/{2} placeholders) are used, so the archive statement would fail at runtime; the original had the same defect for @beforeUtc.

R663.note: Drops the second URLDecoder.decode and validates with toRealPath()+startsWith(), closing the double-encoded traversal; the 404-on-missing-file and removal of double-decode support are both stated.

R664.note: MIME check uses the attacker-supplied Content-Type while the original extension is copied onto the UUID name, so shell.jsp sent as image/png is still written as <uuid>.jsp under the web root; it also adds a 5MB cap and drops the original filename, rejecting uploads the endpoint previously accepted.

R665.note: preg_replace_callback removes the /e eval, but $formatter is still attacker-controlled and reaches call_user_func with is_callable() as the only gate, so formatter=system (the exploit the case file names) still executes arbitrary commands; missing template keys now render the literal {field} instead of an empty string, unstated.

R666.note: Lowercased extension allowlist checked before os.Create stops non-image types landing in the FileServer-served directory; response codes, filename handling and error paths are otherwise unchanged.
